description: Replace all direct console usage with logger across entire codebase. Logger already exists and suppresses output in production. Direct console calls found in: supabase.js, server.js (keep server.js as is - backend needs logging), kloudtechService.js, security.js, and 12+ screen/component files.
steps: Import logger from '../lib/logger' or '../../lib/logger' or '../../../lib/logger' depending on file depth in src/lib/supabase.js, src/services/kloudtechService.js, src/lib/security.js
Replace console.log with logger.log, console.error with logger.error, console.warn with logger.warn in all src/ files (exclude server.js - backend needs console for production logs)
Verify pattern: grep 'console\.(log|error|warn)' in src/ returns only expected logger.js internals
Run npm run build and confirm terser drops console statements from dist/ bundle
acceptance_criteria: No direct console.* calls in src/ directory except inside logger.js itself
npm run build produces dist/ with no console statements (verify with grep or verify-production-build.js)
Dev mode still shows logs via logger
verification: Execute: npx grep -r 'console\.(log|error|warn|info)' src/ --exclude-dir=node_modules | grep -v logger.js (should return empty or only logger.js)
Execute: npm run build && node verify-production-build.js (should pass with no violations)
Execute: npm run dev and check browser console shows logs in development
